name: Tentacle of C'Thun is tracked on the owner's totem bar (#9893, #8065)
contract: Tentacle of C'Thun 801153 is Effect0 SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with EffectMiscValueB 63, a SummonProperties.dbc row with Type SUMMON_TYPE_TOTEM and Slot 1 (Fire) -- confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer against the server's Spell.dbc and the raw SummonProperties.dbc bytes. EffectSummonType (SpellEffects.cpp) routes any Type SUMMON_TYPE_TOTEM summon through Totem::InitStats, which must send SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED before adding the totem to the world for the client's totem bar (dismiss, duration) to track it. PR #8637 (23d0fbca00) wrapped that send inside 'if (GetCreatureType() == CREATURE_TYPE_TOTEM)' together with the racial elemental-totem model override, to stop the tentacle (creature_template type 4, Demon, not 11, Totem) from receiving that model and its plate. Since the tentacle is never CREATURE_TYPE_TOTEM, this incidentally also suppressed SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED for it, regressing the totem-bar tracking #8065/#9893 report, though the one-per-slot bookkeeping (Unit::m_SummonSlot) that TempSummon::InitSummon sets was never affected. The fix sends SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED unconditionally for any totem-slot summon and keeps the model override scoped to CREATURE_TYPE_TOTEM creatures only. SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED (opcode 1043) is newly allow-listed in CoAGameplayTest's packet observer so the harness can see it; its first byte is the zero-based totem bar slot (Slot 1/Fire -> byte 0).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED has been sent yet
DISCRIMINATING: casting the tentacle sends SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED to its owner
The totem bar slot is Fire (slot 1, zero-based byte 0), matching SummonProperties row 63
